name: Home
description: The main landing page for TERI, providing an overview of the institute and its key areas of work. Also the Thematic areas of TERI's research and initiatives are accessible from this page.

name: Outreach
description: TERI's outreach and knowledge-dissemination section, covering events, publications, multimedia, media engagement, and other initiatives that communicate TERI's research and sustainability work to wider audiences.

name: Policy
description: Presents TERI's policy research, analysis, modelling, and advisory work across areas such as energy, climate change, environment, agriculture, and sustainable development.

name: Services
description: Describes TERI's research, consultancy, technical advisory, testing, capacity-building, and implementation services across sustainability-related sectors.

name: technologies
description: Showcases technologies and innovations developed by TERI to address environmental, energy, agricultural, resource-efficiency, and sustainable-development challenges.

name: Centres of Excellence
description: Lists TERI's specialised Centres of Excellence, which bring together research, innovation, policy, capacity building, and partnerships around focused sustainability challenges.

name: founder
description: Provides the history of TERI and profiles its founders, highlighting the institution's origins, evolution, and contribution to energy, environment, and sustainable development.

name: Mission and Goals
description: Explains TERI's mission, goals, values, and broad areas of work, including clean energy, climate resilience, resource efficiency, sustainable habitats, ecosystems, and human well-being.

name: annoucements
description: Publishes TERI's official announcements, notices, tenders, procurement information, calls, and other institutional updates.

name: FCRA Financials
description: Provides TERI's FCRA-related financial disclosures, including audited statements, receipts and payments, income and expenditure statements, balance sheets, and related financial information.

name: Annual Reports
description: An archive of TERI's annual reports containing year-wise information about the institute's activities, research, programmes, achievements, and institutional performance.

name: Alumni
description: Provides information about the TERI Alumni Association and its efforts to connect former members, facilitate knowledge sharing, mentoring, collaboration, and continued engagement with TERI.

name: People - committee of directors
description: Lists members of TERI's Committee of Directors and provides links to individual profiles containing their roles, expertise, and professional backgrounds.

name: people - governing council
description: Lists members of TERI's Governing Council and provides access to individual profiles with information about their professional and institutional backgrounds.

name: people - distinguished fellows
description: Profiles TERI's Distinguished Fellows and Distinguished Fellows Emeriti, highlighting senior experts and their contributions across sustainability, energy, environment, climate, and related fields.

name: Regional centers
description: TERI has regional centres across India that undertake location-specific research, projects, partnerships, capacity building, and outreach in areas such as energy, environment, agriculture, climate, water, biodiversity, and sustainable development.

children.name: Bengaluru
children.description: TERI's Southern Regional Centre in Bengaluru works on industrial energy efficiency, renewable energy, environmental studies, sustainable buildings, water resources, and green materials.

children.name: Goa
children.description: TERI's Western Regional Centre in Goa focuses on coastal ecology, marine resources, water management, agriculture, biodiversity, waste management, climate research, and community capacity building.

children.name: guwahati
children.description: TERI's North-Eastern Regional Centre in Guwahati works on sustainable development in the North East through research and projects in agriculture, biotechnology, rural extension, water, waste, and community development.

children.name: Gurugram
children.description: TERI Gram at Gwal Pahari, Gurugram is a research and development campus focused on green technologies, sustainable habitats, renewable energy, biotechnology, waste and water management, and environmental innovation.

children.name: Mukteshwar - Nainital
children.description: TERI's Himalayan Centre in Mukteshwar, Nainital focuses on community engagement, sustainable livelihoods, agricultural innovation, biodiversity, and development initiatives for Himalayan communities.

children.name: Hyderabad
children.description: TERI's Southern Regional Centre in Hyderabad is a knowledge hub focused on energy transition, research, analysis, capacity building, and collaboration with government, industry, academia, and society.

children.name: Mumbai
children.description: TERI's Western Regional Centre in Mumbai works on environmental monitoring, natural-resource management, nutrition and livelihoods, biodiversity, climate-related projects, CSR, and sustainability consultancy.

name: Sustainable Agriculture Theme
description: Focuses on sustainable and climate-resilient agriculture, including soil health, agricultural productivity, resource efficiency, biotechnology, waste utilisation, and livelihood improvement.

name: Climate Change Theme
description: Covers climate science, climate modelling, vulnerability and impact assessment, adaptation, mitigation, climate policy, and strategies for building climate resilience.

name: Energy Theme
description: Covers energy systems and the transition towards cleaner, more efficient, and lower-carbon energy through renewable energy, energy efficiency, modelling, electricity, fuels, and energy access.

name: Energy Assessment and Modelling Theme
description: Uses energy-system and economic modelling to study energy demand, supply, emissions, technology pathways, and long-term transition scenarios to inform policy and planning.

name: Electricity and Renewables Theme
description: Works on electricity systems and renewable-energy technologies and policies, including solar, wind, hydro, floating solar, solar thermal, and green hydrogen.

name: Energy Efficiency Theme
description: Promotes improved energy performance across buildings and industry through energy audits, efficiency technologies, benchmarking, policy support, and capacity building.

name: Energy Access Theme
description: Focuses on improving reliable and affordable energy access through decentralised energy solutions, renewable technologies, innovative delivery models, and rural development approaches.

name: Environment Theme
description: Addresses environmental challenges through work on air, water, land, forests, biodiversity, waste, biotechnology, marine systems, pollution control, and resource conservation.

name: Water Theme
description: Focuses on water conservation, water-use efficiency, groundwater, watershed management, wastewater treatment, and approaches to long-term water security.

name: Land Theme
description: Addresses land degradation, restoration, sustainable land management, ecosystem resilience, carbon outcomes, and livelihood impacts associated with land resources.

name: Forest & Biodiversity Theme
description: Works on forest conservation, biodiversity, ecosystem services, sustainable forest management, forest-based livelihoods, carbon finance, and human-wildlife interactions.

name: Waste Theme
description: Develops approaches and technologies for waste reduction, recycling, resource recovery, treatment, and circular-economy systems.

name: Air Theme
description: Focuses on air-quality assessment and management through emissions inventories, source apportionment, modelling, monitoring, health-impact studies, and pollution-control strategies.

name: Advanced Biofuels & Biochemicals Theme
description: Develops advanced biofuels, biochar, and biochemical solutions using biomass, waste, and other low-cost feedstocks as part of a circular and sustainable bioeconomy.

name: Pyrolytic Biofuels, Biochar & Green Chemicals Theme
description: Focuses on thermochemical and catalytic conversion of biomass and waste into pyrolytic biofuels, biochar, activated carbon, and green chemicals.

name: Microbial Biofuels and Biochemicals Theme
description: Develops microbial and biotechnological pathways for producing biofuels and biochemicals from agricultural, industrial, algal, and other low-cost organic feedstocks.

name: Industrial Biotechnology Theme
description: Applies biotechnology, specialised microbes, metagenomics, and bioprocess engineering to areas such as bioremediation, resource recovery, carbon conversion, enzymes, and sustainable materials.

name: Marine and Coastal Theme
description: Studies marine and coastal ecosystems, blue carbon, biodiversity, pollution, sustainable aquaculture, resource management, and community livelihoods to support a sustainable blue economy.

name: Sustainable Habitat Theme
description: Promotes sustainable, resilient, and resource-efficient human settlements through work on buildings, transport, cities, urban planning, and low-carbon development.

name: Transport Theme
description: Focuses on sustainable and low-carbon mobility, including electric mobility, transport emissions, energy efficiency, urban transport, railways, and sustainable freight systems.

name: Buildings Theme
description: Advances energy- and resource-efficient buildings through green design, building assessments, energy audits, policy support, capacity building, and sustainable building frameworks.

name: Cities Theme
description: Works towards inclusive, resilient, and sustainable cities through urban research, climate action, planning, governance, capacity building, and data-driven decision-making.

name: Environment and Public Health Theme
description: Examines connections between environmental conditions and public health, including risks associated with air, water, food, pollution, nutrition, and community resilience.

name: Resources & Sustainable Development Theme
description: Focuses on sustainable resource use, resource efficiency, circular economy, waste management, governance, and long-term development pathways.

name: Resource Efficiency & Governance Theme
description: Examines resource demand, efficiency, waste, circular economy, and governance approaches that can reduce environmental impacts while supporting economic development.

name: Centre for Sustainable Development Research Theme
description: Focuses on systemic sustainable-development transitions through policy research, green budgeting, green public procurement, sustainability leadership, knowledge partnerships, and SDG-related initiatives.

name: TERI Council for Business Sustainability Theme
description: Connects TERI with businesses and sustainability leaders to encourage the integration of sustainability into corporate strategy, operations, innovation, and decision-making.

name: Corporate Social Responsibility Theme
description: Supports organisations in designing and implementing CSR and sustainability programmes across areas such as environment, education, livelihoods, water, sanitation, and clean energy.

name: Green Shipping Theme
description: Focuses on reducing the environmental and carbon footprint of the maritime sector through cleaner fuels, policy research, circular approaches, life-cycle assessment, and industry collaboration.

name: World Sustainable Development Summit Theme
description: TERI's flagship annual summit that brings together governments, researchers, businesses, civil society, and other stakeholders to discuss and advance sustainable development and climate action.

name: TERI Knowledge Resource Centre Theme
description: TERI's knowledge and information platform supporting research, learning, information services, digital resources, skill development, and sustainability-focused knowledge initiatives.

name: Knowledge Products and Services Theme
description: Provides information resources and knowledge services that support research, learning, analysis, and professional information needs for TERI and external users.

name: Knowledge Repositories & Information Centre Theme
description: Provides access to TERI's information resources, databases, repositories, and research-support facilities for researchers, institutions, industry, and other users.

name: Skill Development & Awareness Programmes Theme
description: Provides training, skill development, entrepreneurship, and awareness programmes focused on sustainability-related subjects and green livelihood opportunities.

name: Sustainability Driven Knowledge Projects Theme
description: Covers knowledge initiatives that produce databases, studies, surveys, monitoring systems, reports, and evaluation resources to support sustainability research, policy, and implementation.

name: Environment Education Theme
description: Promotes education for sustainable development through research, training, youth engagement, curriculum support, communication, capacity building, and environmental awareness initiatives.

name: Education for Youth Empowerment Theme
description: Uses education for sustainable development to build young people's knowledge, skills, leadership, and capacity to take practical sustainability action in their communities.

name: Strategic Communication for Sustainability Theme
description: Uses strategic communication, education, and behavioural-change approaches to promote environmentally responsible lifestyles and encourage sustainability action.
